tei:div.tei:p: 315)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rtsa gsum spyi gces las bzhi'i thig yig a dar+sha bzhugs so:

na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki yai: rang rig rtsa gsum lha la 'dud: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas ngas: rjes 'jug 'gro ba skyob pa'i phyir: gter rigs bco brgyad la sogs pa: khams dbang dang bstun chos gter dang: rdzas dang nor gter du ma sbas: khyad par las phran bsam mi khyab: 'di ni las bzhi'i cho ga la: 'jug nas lhag chad bskang ba dang: gang 'dod dngos grub bskul ba'i thabs: me dkyil bkod thabs rim pa bstan: dang po las bzhi gang la yang: cha bkod bya rjes sogs tshangs thig brgyad gdab bya: dang por mu khyud rim bzin dbus: rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i: lte bar hrīḥraṃ dbu can bya: de'i phyi mu khyud gnyis pa la: pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar mtha' ser dbus dang: pad tshab dbus ma'i mdog dang bstun: de'i phyi mu khyud gsum pa la: pad 'dab nyer lnga mdzes tshon bya: de'i phyi mu khyud bzhi pa la: phyogs dang mthun pa'i 'dab bzhi bkod: de'i phyi mu khyud lnga pa la: rdo rwa ser po bzhi 'ja' zer thig le ni: thabs shes mtshon phyir dbus mtshas g.yas g.yon ljang mtshal spang bya: de'i phyi mu khyud drug pa la: lnga ldan 'ja' mdzes tshon skor ris su bkod: phyi khyams phyogs 316) bzhi phyogs mdog dang: mtshams bzhir zla phyed rdo rje rnams kyi zla ba dkyil 'khor la bstan rdo rjes bteg: zla ba rang mdog rdor ser bya: de yis zhi ba'i las rim rdzogs: sa ma ya: gnyis par mu khyud rim bzhin dbus: zlum po lte bar gser rdo rje: rtse gsum mam ni 'dod nor bu dmar ser 'byung nor: raṃ dang lha yi sa bon lha gang yin gyi bkod: gnyis par mu khyud gru bzhi'i dbus: kha chod zlum mthar pad 'khor gyi lha grangs ltar 'dab ni: ljang mtha' ser dbus mtshams rnams dbus dang bstun: gsum pa'i mu khyud gru bzhi pa'i: nang du rin chenanor bu g.yas skor phreng ba dang: thig le 'ja' zer drwa bas sbrel: snang stong mtshon phyir li thig dbus mthing g.yas g.yon bya:

bzhi pa'i mu khyud gru bzhi par: me ri nor dmar ser 'dzin pa g.yas skor tra bkod: phyi khyams phyogs bzhi phyogs mdog dang: mtshams bzhir zla phyed rdo rje yi: rin chen mig gsum nor bu'i dbus dmar po/ g.yas g.yon ljang gu yag dbus li khri/ g.yas g.yon mthing*/ des 'gres so/ mdzes tshon bya: de yis rgyas pa'i las rim rdzogs: sa ma ya: gsum par mu khyud rim bzhin dbus: zlum bskor lte bar chos 'byung ni: mdun rgyab spang ba'i lto ba ru: raṃ dang lha yi sa bon bri:de'i phyi mu khyud gnyis pa la: pad 'dab mtha' mthing mtshal dbus mtshams dbus mdog: gsum par mu khyud zla gam bya: pad phreng pad+ma dmar skya bzhi thig le 'od sbrel ba: dbyings ye mtshon phyir dmar ser g.yas g.yon bya: bzhi par mu khyud zla gam nang: dbang gi me ri 317) g.yon dmar ser 'khyil bkod: phyi khyams phyogs bzhi phyogs mdog dang: mtshams rnams zla phyed pad+mas mtshan: zla ba rang mdog pad dmar bya: de yis dbang gi las rim rdzogs: sa ma ya: bzhi par mu khyud rim bzhin dbus: mu khyud nyis rim lte ba la: rdo rje rtse gsum rwa gdengs kyi: lto bar raṃ dang sa bon ni: dbu can mtshan gyis bri bar bya: mu khyud phyi mar chad 'dab ni: dbus mthing ser mtha' bya zhing pad tshab rnams: dbus kyi mdog dang bstun par bya: de nas gru gsum sum rim gyi: mu khyud dang por thod phreng kha nang bstan bkod: de'i phyi mu khyud gnyis pa la: ral gri dang ni mtshams rnams su: bden gnyis ral gri sngon po g.yon bskor gsum/ yu ba ser po/ rtse dmar po/ thig le nyes rim gyi dbus sngon po/ g.yas g.yon gyi dbus dmar po/ mtshon phyir thig les sbrel: de'i phyi mu khyud gsum pa la: dmar nag drag po'i me ri ni: cha rer gsum gsum dgu bskor bya: phyi khyams phyogs bzhi phyogs mdog dang: zla phyed dang ni ral gri sngon po/ yu ba ser/ rtse dmar yis:

mtshams bzhi bteg pa'i tshul du bkod: de yis drag po'i las rim rdzogs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gu h+ya: brda thim: : de ltar rtsa gsum spyi gces cha rkyen 'di: tshul khrims rdo rje nan chags che ba yis: 'dug tu ma 318) ster yang yang bskul ba dang: phan bde dang ni chos dbyings sgron ma yis: mos pas bskul phyir dus kun zhal rdzun mkhan: sprang 'khyams ma nus bde skyong dbang mo yis: ser dgon dben gnas mtshams phrod ljongs nas bris: dge 'dis gsang sngags bstan pa mtha' rgyas shog: ha ha: chos min chos 'di yig min ris su bkod// bu min bu 'dra'i shī la badz+ra gyis// spyan zur g.yo bzhin dag ther nan tan mdzod/ de min dgos med mang po ngas mi bri// rang gzhan le lo dang ni mi khom gzhi// zin med bya ba dang mtshungs skyur la thongs// bdag ni na so rgas pa'i rkyen dbang gis// spros bcas gzhung chen bri spel mi nus pas// gang bde sgyid lugs rang du nyal snying 'dod/ ha ha/ dge'o//
